name: Suspension at five complainants in ten days (r. 25(5)(d), 2025)

attrs.quote: if it is found that number of complaints against the Sender are from five or more than five unique Recipients during last ten days
attrs.scope: Originating Access Providers, for unregistered telemarketers
attrs.note: Regulation 25 was substituted again by the Third Amendment, 2026.
